lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Distinct columns of high-luminance circular spots are visible posterior to the branchial region. The spots are arranged in roughly vertical rows with regular spatial intervals between centroids.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary high-luminance blobs, forming a discernible grid-like structure across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible across the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp transition from highlight to shadow (vertical luminance gradient).

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of two Echeneidae individuals (remoras) attached to the visible right pectoral fin.
